narr: Isolated thunderstorms moved erratically across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. In the Tucson Metro, localized flash flooding occurred and a landspout was spotted.
ev: Heavy rain of 1-1.5 southeast of Valencia and Mission Rds. caused the West Branch of the Santa Cruz River to flood Drexel Road, causing its closure.
Heavy rain of 1-1.5 on Tucson's southeast side caused localized flash flooding. Escalante Rd. was closed at the Atterbury Wash and a man was rescued from his vehicle in the Alamo Wash at Yale Dr.
lsr: SWIFT-WATER RESCUE NEAR ALAMO WASH AND YALE DRIVE. DRIVER ON TOP OF VEHICLE FOR RESCUE.
